data.message: Now that you have the people registered, soldiers drafted and fight events in place, you will have to simulate the fights. Expose a page in your app at /simulate, and replay each fight. For each fight, launch a background process, then decrease the health points of the defender according to the event of the fight. Fight background processes have to run in parallel. Watch out for concurrency issues. Display the results of fights in HTML on the page mentioned in your app.
